question: Does Jiangsu Provincial Ancient Books Digital Resource Integration Platform establish a lawful, anonymous original-image route for Wuxi 02911 (Ming1608) or Yangzhou 02273 (Xu-An1599 supplemented), specifically original juan45?
inherited_exact_witnesses: Wuxi Government-approved fifth-batch item 02911: Xing 72 juan, Ming1608 Zhang Chongli and Wang Guozhen printed edition, Wuxi Library; no surviving-juan statement
Yangzhou third-batch item 02273: Xu-An1599 with supplementary leaves, text known only from secondary republication; provincial original appendix .doc item text not directly read
NCL06273 Sun Wei1608 is not proven the same plates as Wuxi's Zhang/Wang attribution

sources.provider: Soochow University Library, institutional resource guide
sources.direct_scope: Reports a December 2024 platform launch, 5035 works/24644 fascicles of Nanjing Library original-image resources; 'Jiangsu ancient-book holdings catalogue' then contains only Classics (经部); states guest access as a usage description.

sources.provider: Inner Mongolia Normal University Library, institutional guide
sources.direct_scope: Reports 5035 works/24644 fascicles of Nanjing Library images, and describes free access requiring registration/login; catalogue thematic coverage then includes Classics (经部).

Describes open browsing without prior registration; 5035 works/24644 fascicles and 104807 catalog entries. This conflicts at access-detail level with other university guides, not proof that any named Xing title is available.
Confirms Su Zheng Fa [2012] No. 86 approval of 249 items and links original .doc appendix; web text extraction rejects .doc as unsupported application/msword and does not validate item 02273 text.
Direct first-party item 02911 bibliographic lead, no exact Wuxi shelfmark, copy extent or original juan45 scan.

checks.explanation: Platform service descriptions name Nanjing Library's 5035 scanned works and cannot establish Wuxi's individual target is hosted.
No verified first-party appendix item text, surviving leaf inventory or image; 'supplemented' cannot be dated uniformly.
One institutional guide says guest browsing, another says registration; no authenticated target file/image was obtained. No registration or user action attempted.

checks.target: Jiangsu holdings catalog search for Xing in 子部
checks.explanation: The '江苏省古籍存藏目录' subdatabase in cited platform descriptions covers 经部 only. Do not construe a prospective negative search there as evidence the 子部 title is absent from holdings.
Official HTML confirms attachment, but application/msword cannot be read in the current web reader; secondary item text remains secondary, not promoted to first-party original.

edges_rejected_or_unproved: Digital-service platform availability or catalogue item counts cannot be used as a transmission connection among Wuxi, Yangzhou and NCL06273 physical printed witnesses.
unresolved_lineage_questions: Need authenticated Xu-An early original juan45 L132 二/三 and native 疾 construction with radix/carry, with dated print plate and actual leaf context.
Need Wuxi 02911 surviving-juan/shelfmark from direct holding inventory, plus Yangzhou 02273 original appendix and replacement-leaf scope.

next_action: Prioritize item-bound, openly accessible original Xu-An juan45 (Zhejiang 善002648, NCL06270, SYSU, museum and documented facsimile/film routes). Seek Wuxi exact holdings census record and Yangzhou government original appendix only if publicly readable. Do not make account-based provincial platform an acquisition dependency.
